channels.section_help: Add a platform channel. Owners and editors start a bio-token claim — paste the token in the channel About/bio and verify below. Leftover pending rows can be deleted; bound channels can be archived.

profiles.merge_desc_short: Merge this creator into another. All channels, links, and claims will be moved to the destination.

ajax.channel_claim_started: Channel claim started. Paste the token in your channel bio to verify.

claims.title: Become a vTuber / Claim profile
claims.subtitle: Claim an admin-seeded orphan profile by putting a token in the channel About/bio.
claims.accept_anyway_help: Staff QA only: skip bio check when enabled. Confirm claimant identity first.
claims.token_help: Add this exact string to the channel About (YouTube) or bio (Twitch), then press Verify.
claims.empty_claimable: No claimable orphan profiles right now.
claims.no_channels: No channels on this profile — staff must register a channel first.
claims.orphan_help: Staff only: creates a profile without binding you as owner. Use a separate personal account if you are also a vTuber.
claims.expires_help: When this claim request expires (not the verify-attempt cooldown). Start a new claim after expiry.
claims.staff_subtitle: Seed orphan profiles and review pending claims. Do not bind staff accounts as owners.
claims.user_create_note: Self-create owner profiles is still available via API for legacy paths; staff UI seeds orphans only.

credentials.subtitle: Multi-key integration secrets (Root/Admin). Mask only — secrets never re-displayed.
credentials.label: Label
credentials.secret_leave_blank: Leave secret fields blank to keep the existing secret.
credentials.create_pending_note: New credentials start as pending. Press Test before workers can use them.
credentials.edit_pending_note: Saving changes sets the credential to pending. Run Test again before workers can use it.

probe.title: Platform API probe
probe.subtitle: Permanent Root/Admin debug tool for PlatformApiGateway (live YouTube/Twitch). Uses the active credential. Not temporary.
probe.ids_help: Videos: raw video/VOD ids. Channels/streams: user id, login, {'@'}handle, or profile URL (auto-normalized to canonical id). Max 50 videos/channels, 100 streams. Over limit hard-fails unless chunked.
probe.handle_help: For resolve_channel only (YouTube {'@'}handle or Twitch login).
probe.parts_help: Comma-separated, e.g. snippet,contentDetails. Leave blank for defaults.

confirm.archive_channel_body: Archive this channel? It will be hidden from the active list.
confirm.delete_pending_channel_body: Delete this pending channel? It was never bound to a platform identity. This cannot be undone.
confirm.accept_anyway_body: Accept this claim without verifying the channel bio? Confirm claimant identity first.
confirm.merge_body: Merge this profile into the selected destination? All data moves and this profile will be archived. This cannot be undone.
confirm.revoke_credential_body: Revoke this credential? Workers will stop using it until you edit and Test again.
confirm.verify_channel_body: Re-fetch the channel bio and check for the token?

intro.title: Platform integration credentials
intro.lead: Store API keys and OAuth secrets per platform. Workers use active credentials by priority.

steps.title: Add credential
steps.body: Create a labeled secret for the platform (API key, OAuth app, or bearer token).

steps.title: Test gate
steps.body: New credentials stay pending until Test succeeds — this verifies connectivity.

steps.title: Worker pickup
steps.body: Active credentials are selected by lowest priority number; failover skips unhealthy keys.
